audit_title: Research positioning: independently recounted MetaWorld evidence

audit_scope.bayesian_limit: The four raw Bayesian evaluation files are manifests for losslessly compressed chunk archives. Counts, latency and per-task values here are sourced from the existing compact final analysis, not independently recounted from the full chunked records.

interpretation_limits: One training seed and repeatedly reused development cases do not establish independent generalization or training-seed uncertainty.
Method ports use a shared custom world and benchmark; these are not authors native benchmark scores.
Equal update and compute ceilings do not imply equal consumed compute or matched convergence.
Historical representation/world changes prevent pooling historical results with the current comparison.
Cross-run differences do not isolate flow generation, repair, retrieval, TTT, reasoning or other bundled components.

selected_whole_rollout_oracle_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive oracle over completed policy rollouts from the same resets. It is not a candidate-action oracle from the same intermediate state, an implementable ensemble result, or measured attainable policy success.

findings.counterfactual_ranking_gap: Lower factual encoded prediction error on executed prefixes does not establish improved ranking of unexecuted actions by physical progress or task success.
findings.deadline_gap: Flow reasoning, progress TTT and guided TTT have controller timeout failures. The two selected bounded-repair controllers have zero timeouts at about86ms mean per decision.
findings.diversity_caution: Proposal contraction accompanies both improving and worsening success curves; it is not an established failure cause.
